name: Buomman
printedArtCredit: Steve Prescott, A buomman monk, p. 9.
sourceDistinctions: The vow forbids speech and allows Buommi song. One violation deals Wisdom damage and applies a 24-hour penalty. Further violations damage Wisdom again and extend the penalty.
Nonverbal Spell substitutes a sound for verbal spell components and still fails in magical silence. Silent Spell removes the verbal component using a higher slot.
Both encounters are on the Material Plane, where the Astral-native Buomman has the Extraplanar subtype.
